notes: Stop names are the tab labels from the official Styles sheet ('Stop' column). The organ has four styles (e.g. Baroque, Romantic, English, Symphonic) that rename and revoice the stops.
Couplers and tremulants are not in the Styles sheet; they come from the Physis manual's panel description (2-manual models: I/P, II/P, II/I, tremulants on each manual).
EU standard voicing (German stop names). The UK Sonus 40 has an English stop list: see viscount-sonus-40-uk.
Some reports say the Sonus 40 sends only notes (no stop messages); the Physis manual (which covers Sonus 40/45) documents stop SysEx. Check on your organ.

Stops transmit Viscount SysEx F0 31 4n xx yy F7 (on) / F0 31 0n xx yy F7 (off), n = section channel, xx yy = internal voice ID. Voice IDs are not published for this model (and change if an alternative voice is selected), so no stop bindings are included: use Learn every stop.

Couplers are only received (F0 31 2F 70 vv F7), not transmitted; tremulant on/off is sent as tremulant speed/depth SysEx (depth 00 = off), which a stop binding cannot express. Learn or set these by hand.
all_stops_off is the documented Viscount Cancel message F0 31 2F 6C 00 F7. Expression pedals send CC11 (0-127) on the section's channel; divisional volumes send CC7 (not mapped).
Check on your organ: the channel numbers are factory defaults and can be changed in the organ's MIDI menu (a dealer may have changed them).

Stop list: https://www.viscountinstruments.it/media/wysiwyg/pdf/supporto/Disposition/Sonus/SONUS%2040%20EU%20STANDARD%20-%20Styles.pdf (official Viscount disposition sheet; no longer on viscountinstruments.it, retrieved from the Internet Archive copy)
Stop list: https://viscountorgans.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/2447_Sonus-40_Flipbook.pdf (console facts: 2 x 61 notes, 30-note pedalboard, 34 stops, Swell expression pedal plus crescendo)

MIDI scheme: https://www.viscountinstruments.com/img/PhysisEU_ReferenceManual-EN-v117-7.pdf (Physis Organs Reference Manual EU v1.17, sect. 14.6 Detailed MIDI implementation, pp. 115-118: 2-manual defaults Man.II=ch1, Man.I=ch2, Pedal=ch4, ch16 system)
